summary: Braskem S.A. filed a Form 6-K with the SEC as a foreign private issuer, reporting the detailed final voting map from its Ordinary and Extraordinary General Meeting held on June 8, 2026. The meeting covered routine governance items such as amendments to articles of incorporation to reflect a new Shareholders' Agreement (referenced in an April 23, 2026 Material Fact) and consolidation of bylaws. No merger, acquisition, tender offer, or other special-situations transaction is disclosed. This is a routine disclosure of shareholder votes on ordinary corporate housekeeping matters, not a special situation.
